messages:
Priya: Quick thread to align on the 'tooling-shim' distro for LangChain/LlamaIndex + gateway orchestration. Goal: single install that SIs can drop into customer clusters and that we can publish to cloud marketplaces. High level: container + helm + small CLI for local dev.
Ethan: Nice. Main things to surface for marketplace listing: what's packaged, supported platforms, tested hw, and a short troubleshooting section. Also need the compatibility matrix (langchain/LlamaIndex versions).
Priya: Agreed. Proposed package contents:
- container image + chart
- sample langchain agent adapter (python)
- CLI: redwood-shim init/start/status
- sample app demonstrating streaming->UI and function calls
- smoke tests for SI runbook
Ravi: From infra side: include node affinity examples for GPU types and an optional config to prefer quantized variants. Chart should expose modelVariant and quantizationMode values. Also add readiness probe that verifies KV cache warmup.
Priya: Draft values.yaml snippet:
```yaml
image:
  repo: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/tooling-shim
  tag: 0.1.0
helm:
  replicaCount: 2
  hostNetworking: false
adapter:
  langchain:
    supportedVersions: ["0.0.200", "0.0.201"]
auth:
  tokenExchange:
    enabled: true
    endpoint: https://token.redwood.io/exchange
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefixTTL: 20
observability:
  metricsPrefix: redwood.tooling_shim
```
Ethan: For the CLI, add a 'bundle' command that packages the helm chart + sample app for offline SI installs. Also a 'validate' command that runs smoke tests against a target cluster and outputs a simple pass/fail.
Ravi: Perf guidance: include recommended batch sizes and max tokens for each model family. We'll include three test points: 256/512/1024 tokens with batch 4/8/16. Provide latency & throughput numbers for a100 and h100 in the marketplace assets.
CI-Bot: CI: smoke tests passed on main (sha: def456). Helm lint OK. Artifact pushed: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/tooling-shim:0.1.0.
Nora: Marketing/legal notes: need a short data handling blurb (what logs we collect, opt-out for telemetry), and language for co-branded listings: partner logo rules + approval flow. Also require a short support SLA for marketplace (e.g., 30-day support window for initial GA customers).
Priya: Good call. On the compatibility matrix: we'll support LangChain runner v0.30+ and LlamaIndex v0.8+ initially. Add a note: community contributions for older versions accepted but not supported.
Ethan: SI handoff checklist idea:
- KIT: chart + sample app + CLI + perf report + troubleshooting doc
- onboarding runbook: smoke test steps + expected outputs + how to switch quantized/unquantized artifacts
- contact: SE alias + escalation path
Ravi: Add recommended kube tuning: ephemeral-storage limits for KV cache, cpu pinning for adapter, and nodeSelector labels for GPU SKUs. Provide example kustomize overlay for private deployments.
Priya: Timeline: aim to publish marketplace bundle (private listing) next Tue for partner early access. Public listing + joint announcement two weeks after: need LangChain signoff and a quick partner co-demo.
Nora: I'll draft the marketplace TOC and the data handling blurb by EOD Friday. Also will kick off legal review with LangChain for co-branding.
Ethan: Action items:
- Priya: sample app + CLI docs + schedule demo (due Mon)
- Ravi: perf matrix + kube tuning docs + kustomize overlay (due Thu)
- Nora: marketplace TOC + telemetry blurb + legal outreach (due Fri)
- Ethan: packaging scripts (bundle/validate) + onboarding runbook (due Thu)
Priya: Sync on Friday 11am PT to review assets before handoff to PM/marketing. Any objections?
Ethan: Works for me.
Ravi: Good.
Nora: Sounds good, will RSVP.
Priya: Thanks all — I'll upload initial README and invite the partners channel to the demo once the bundle is ready.
